current_state: 08-03 Docker dashboard packaging is implemented locally. Dockerfile builds web/dist in a Node stage and copies it into the runtime image; CI now runs a container smoke for /v1/health/simple, /dashboard, and one hashed /dashboard/assets bundle. Local Docker socket is unavailable, so final runtime proof is pending GitHub Actions after push.

decisions.decision: Open Phase 08 rather than tagging immediately.
decisions.rationale: User asked to keep building OpenHub. Codebase concerns still list CI absence and dashboard packaging verification as critical release gaps.

decisions.decision: CI must use dummy credentials and local temp DB state only.
decisions.rationale: OpenHub is security-first; no local admin/API/provider secrets belong in repository or CI logs.

decisions.decision: Docker must bundle dashboard assets rather than relying on checkout-local web/dist.
decisions.rationale: FastAPI only mounts /dashboard when web/dist/index.html exists beside the app; release packaging must prove the image contains and serves those assets.
